output.reason: Weeks of hopelessness with new suicidal thinking framed as being a burden to others is a warning sign requiring immediate in-person mental health assessment, with plan, intent and means access unknown.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now, or call/text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) right away if you need support while getting there. Thoughts that everyone would be better off without you, after weeks of hopelessness, need same-hour in-person assessment. Ask someone you trust to stay with you and take you. If you feel you might act on these thoughts, call 911 immediately.
